title: mview viewer
brief: Browser frontend for mview: a local viewer for Markdown (with embedded Mermaid), raw Mermaid diagrams and JSON, opened from a file with live reload, the clipboard, stdin or an empty paste page.

artboards.title: Reader
artboards.tradeoff: Calm, centered reading column with a minimal top bar; best for long Markdown, tools stay out of the way but JSON and diagrams get fewer on-screen controls

artboards.title: Workbench
artboards.tradeoff: IDE-like outline, inspector and status bar; everything visible and dense, heavier chrome for quick reads

artboards.title: Focus canvas
artboards.tradeoff: Full-bleed content with one floating pill and a ⌘K palette; maximum space for diagrams, lower discoverability
